About.metaDesc: PostMyGlobe is an interactive platform to explore the world with a 3D globe and discover country information.
About.heading: About PostMyGlobe
About.subheading: Explore the world with an interactive 3D globe
About.whatIsBody: PostMyGlobe is an interactive platform where you can explore 200+ countries on a 3D globe and compare stats at a glance. Click data and votes from users worldwide are reflected in real time, and anyone can leave comments or drop a promo pin on any country.
About.f1Desc: Explore the Earth with drag, zoom, inertia, and auto-rotation. Clicks accumulate in real time, and Random Spin lands you on a new country.
About.f2Desc: View capital, population, area, official languages, currency, and time zones for any country.
About.f3Desc: Convert between world currencies using live exchange rate data.
About.f4Desc: Compare two countries side by side — population, area, language, and more.
About.f5Desc: Filter countries by region and rank them by population or area.
About.f6Desc: Vote on a new country-related question every day at midnight and see how the world voted.
About.f7Desc: Leave a short comment on any country and read what others think.
About.f8Desc: Post your service or news on any country for the world to see. Each promo stays live for 7 days.
About.guidelineSubtext: PostMyGlobe aims to be a place anyone can enjoy comfortably. Please follow the rules below.
About.commentRule1: Comments containing URLs or links are automatically blocked.
About.commentRule2: You can post one comment per country per day.
About.commentRule3: Profanity, hate speech, and personal information are prohibited.
About.commentRule4: You can report inappropriate comments using the report button.
About.pinRule1: Only real, accessible websites can be registered (automatic DNS verification).
About.pinRule2: URL shorteners (e.g. bit.ly) are not allowed.
About.pinRule3: Promos are automatically removed 3 days after posting.
About.pinRule4: Misinformation, malicious sites, and illegal content promotion are prohibited.
About.pinRule5: You can register up to 3 promos per day.
About.sanctionNotice: Content that accumulates reports or is deemed inappropriate by the operator may be removed without prior notice. For inquiries, please use the
About.data2Desc: GDP, debt ratio, interest rates and other economic indicators
About.techList: Next.js (App Router) · TypeScript · Tailwind CSS · Supabase · D3.js · Vercel
About.authorBody: PostMyGlobe started as a personal project driven by curiosity about country data. More features are added regularly.

Privacy.metaDesc: PostMyGlobe privacy policy. Information about data collection, usage, and third-party services.
Privacy.heading: Privacy Policy
Privacy.intro: PostMyGlobe (the "Service") values user privacy and complies with applicable laws. This policy explains what information the Service collects and how it is used.
Privacy.section1Intro: The Service does not require account registration to identify users. Only the following minimal information is processed.
Privacy.ipDesc: To enforce rate limits and prevent comment spam, IP addresses are converted to a one-way hash (SHA-256) before storage. Original IPs are never stored.
Privacy.clickDataDesc: Aggregate data on how many times each country has been clicked. This is not linked to individual users.
Privacy.commentsDesc: Text submitted directly by users, displayed under a nickname or anonymously.
Privacy.localStorageDesc: The list of countries you have clicked is saved only in your browser's local storage and is never sent to our servers.
Privacy.purpose1: Aggregate per-country click rankings and provide real-time statistics
Privacy.purpose3: Improve service quality and respond to errors
Privacy.section3Intro: The Service uses the following third-party services. Please review each service's own privacy policy.
Privacy.supabaseDesc: Database and real-time features. Stores click counts and comment data.
Privacy.vercelDesc: Hosting and edge network. Server request logs may be temporarily processed.
Privacy.googleAdSenseDesc: Advertising service. Google may use browsing data to serve personalized ads and uses cookies.
Privacy.googleFontsDesc: Font loading may trigger requests to Google servers.
Privacy.section4Desc: The Service does not directly create cookies. However, third-party ad services such as Google AdSense may use cookies for ad personalization. You can disable cookies in your browser settings, though some features may be limited.
Privacy.retention1: Click aggregate data: retained for the duration of the service
Privacy.retention2: Comments: retained for the duration of the service; deleted upon user request
Privacy.retention3: IP hashes: automatically deleted after rate limit expiry (max 24 hours)
Privacy.section6Desc: You have the right to request deletion of comments you have posted. Please submit requests via the
Privacy.section7Desc: This policy may be updated as the Service changes. The updated date at the top of this page will reflect any changes. Material changes may be announced within the Service.
Privacy.section8Desc: For privacy-related inquiries, please use the

Contact.metaDesc: Report bugs, suggest features, or send data corrections to PostMyGlobe.
Contact.heading: Contact
Contact.subheading: Bug reports, feature requests, data corrections — all welcome.
Contact.bugReportDesc: You can report bugs or suggest new features via GitHub Issues. Including reproduction steps, browser info, and screenshots helps us respond faster.
Contact.dataErrorDesc: If country information or statistics are incorrect, please let us know. Including the data source and the correct value helps us update it quickly.
Contact.commentDeleteDesc: To delete a comment you posted, please submit a request via GitHub Issues. Include the country name and comment text so we can locate and remove it.
Contact.responseTime: PostMyGlobe is a personal project. Responses may take several days.
